limits: no cross-salt cohort merging; no private output-dependent optimization
source/canonical numeric and full-cap bounds identical; ordinary and fixed1 controls separate
partial v3 partitions conserve known base + known output-dependent + residual
no inferred avoided correction bytes or rows from cache hit labels
publisher/tokenizer/checkpoint artifact distribution and disk unknown, separate
fresh-interpreter encrypted restart tested by parent, not this cohort
semantic body linear MAC denominator excludes attention, nonlinear work, head, masks and Preparation
low_gate_scope: largest recorded client lifetime peak across every replicate and workload; observed RSS only, not conservative runtime or whole-device admission; tiny fixtures do not qualify checkpoint execution

decode_owner.scope: additional client owner envelope already in native topology estimate; not added twice

wan_settings.scope: rate-admitted TCP payload; HTTP/WebSocket/TLS framing included; each directed stream counted once

windows.aggregate_cpu: launcher plus all reaped client/provider children through complete cleanup
windows.all_link_tcp: native topology/relay startup through role and relay shutdown
windows.client: process birth through response state hashing, client and disk-owner close
windows.covered_bodies: client construction through close, v3 controls/ACK included
windows.disk: owner bind through close, every encrypted read/write including cold publication and orphans
windows.provider_cpu: birth through client exit; shutdown excluded
windows.provider_rss: 50ms sampled after startup through client exit; startup peak unknown
windows.request: ordinary SDK request start through terminal stream; hashing and publication separately charged in lifecycle
